patch_description: Crossover of the two programs: keeps the superior hexagonal-lattice initialization from the current program (which already reached sum 1.34), but improves it in two ways. First, all pairwise distance computations are vectorized with numpy broadcasting, dramatically cutting the eval time of both the relaxation loop and the radii computation. Second, instead of a fixed uniform target radius during relaxation, we alternate between (a) computing exact max radii via vectorized proportional scaling and (b) pushing overlapping circles apart proportionally to their current radii — a Lloyd-style relaxation adapted to the actual radii, letting larger circles dominate. Additionally, several lattice spacings are tried and the best-sum arrangement is kept, improving robustness of the initial layout. Output format (centers, radii, sum_radii) is unchanged.
